name: 粤语·俗语歇后语
author: VoxCPM2
description: 粤语文化延伸插件：俗语、歇后语、童谣民谣与民俗注解。文本中出现查询指令（如「俗语：扮猪食老虎」）时自动讲解并剥离指令。全部内容注明来源与置信度，不虚构。
description_en: Cantonese culture-extension plugin: proverbs, xiehouyu (two-part allegorical sayings), nursery rhymes and folklore notes. Query commands in text are answered and stripped. All content carries source and confidence tags; nothing is fabricated.
